scripts.code:
# Anti-Popup Script
# Continuously watches popup_check region.
# If a popup is detected, clicks popup_close to dismiss it.

while True:
	scan([wrong_chair_1, wrong_chair_2, popup_check, super_roll_1, super_roll_2])
	if popup_check.ocr:
		log("🚫 Popup detected — closing...")
		popup_close.click('h')
		sleep(0.5)
	if super_roll_1 or super_roll_2:
		if wrong_chair_1 or wrong_chair_2:
			kb_press('space')
			kb_hold('w', 1)
	sleep(0.3)
    if btn_teleport:
        log("🏁 Play Again")
        sleep(0.4)
        btn_teleport.click('h', hold=0.05, repeat=3)
        sleep(SETTLE)
        continue

POLL   = 0.3   # seconds between scans while waiting
SETTLE = 0.3   # short pause after a click before re-scanning

while True:
    m = str(mode).lower().strip()

    # ── Scan everything upfront ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    scan([btn_split, btn_steal, btn_confirm])
    btn_split_shift.scan([h])
    btn_steal_shift.scan([h])

    clicked = False

    # ── Phase 1: initial split/steal button ─────────────────────────────────
    if m == "split" and btn_split:
        log("✅ Split button found — clicking")
        btn_split.click('h')
        sleep(SETTLE)
        clicked = True

    elif m == "steal" and btn_steal:
        log("✅ Steal button found — clicking")
        btn_steal.click('h')
        sleep(SETTLE)
        clicked = True

    # ── Phase 2: shifted confirm (highlight-locked button) ───────────────────
    if not clicked:
        shifted = btn_split_shift if m == "split" else btn_steal_shift
        if shifted:
            if not bool(shifted.hl):
                log("🔄 Shifted button not highlighted — clicking to select")
                shifted.click('h')
                sleep(POLL)
            else:
                log("✅ Shifted button highlighted — confirming")
                btn_confirm.click('h', hold=0.05, repeat=3)
                sleep(POLL)

    # ── Phase 3: teleport / play again ──────────────────────────────────────

    sleep(SETTLE)
